ينتحروا (form VIII)
# يَنْتَحِرُوا (yantaḥirū) /jan.ta.ħi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# يُنْتَحَرُوا (yuntaḥarū) /jun.ta.ħa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
